parent_objective: probe whether old-key-aware exact repair can move beyond retention-only alpha while preserving proof gates

public_gates: old-key neighborhood targeted replay and replay-gate adapter
source-diverse protected gates if old-key replay passes
M183/M170 and M267/M264 first replay gates if proof gates pass
forbidden_shortcuts: do not skip old-key targeted replay
do not treat surrogate success as proof without replay
hypothesis: Old-key-aware exact repair can generate a candidate that improves or preserves exact M297/M270 and old-key surrogate metrics without immediately requiring alpha 0.00025 clipping under old-key replay.
success_criteria: old-key-aware repair candidate passes exact M297/M270 and old-key surrogate gates
old-key targeted replay has zero accepted regressions or exposes a larger safe alpha than M358
source-diverse and first replay gates are run if old-key replay passes
failure is classified if the direction remains retention-only
failure_criteria: old-key-aware repair cannot move beyond base without exact or old-key surrogate regression
old-key replay fails at the same micro-alpha scale as M358

commands.name: old_key_aware_repair
commands.command: Run exact_post_ppo_repair with --old-key-preference-npz from M363 and no PPO.

commands.name: old_key_replay_gate
commands.command: Run old_key_neighborhood_targeted_replay and old_key_neighborhood_replay_gate for any exact-feasible candidate.

decision_rule: M364 is complete when the old-key-aware repair probe either admits a proof-gate candidate for full replay or classifies the remaining repair bottleneck without promotion.
